claim: The casters' buffers are not stable for the pass: per launch about 350 thousand DISCARD and 5.2 million NOOVERWRITE vertex or index buffer locks fall between the pass's first and last draw (about 3.8 and 56 a pass), all on the render thread; instancing streams are in use (FREQ 0x4000xxxx and 0x80000001), and 60-75 state blocks are captured and applied inside the pass, so a Set* hook does not see every bound shader. Replay after the pass (route 1 variant b) would read overwritten data: only inline duplication at each draw is correct, and the bound shader must be read at the draw
